rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: confirm army supply increased and bank decreased; if not, repeat queue.
rules.correction: Queue 2-3 Zerglings or Roaches from each available Hatchery, prioritizing units that counter the enemy's known composition. If a Spawning Pool is missing, build it first. If bank remains above 2000 after queuing, add a second Hatchery or an Evolution Chamber if tech is needed. Do not expand unless army supply is at least 15 and production is active.
rules.title: Maintain production tempo while preserving economy/expansion opening
rules.when: At any time before 6 minutes, if army supply is below 15 and bank is above 1500, or if active production structures are fewer than 2 and bank is above 1000.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: verify army composition counters enemy units and production is active.
rules.correction: Queue Roaches or Banelings if a Roach Warren or Baneling Nest is available; otherwise, build the required structure first. If enemy has Siege Tanks, prioritize speed and flanking units like Banelings or Mutalisks if tech is available. Continue expanding only if army supply is above 15 and production is not idle.
rules.title: Respond to Terran ground composition with tech and counters
rules.when: If enemy intelligence shows heavy Marine production (e.g., multiple Barracks with tech labs) or Siege Tanks, and your army supply is below 30.

rules.check: Recheck at next decision cycle: confirm army supply increased and bank decreased; if not, repeat queue and consider additional defensive structures.
rules.correction: Immediately queue 4-6 Zerglings or Roaches from all Hatcheries, prioritizing units that counter the enemy's known composition. If a Spawning Pool is missing, build it first. If bank remains above 3000 after queuing, add a Spine Crawler at each base. Do not expand or tech until army supply is at least 15 and bank is below 1000.
rules.title: Recover from low army and high bank by converting resources into defense
rules.when: If army supply is below 10 and bank is above 2000, or if predicted advantage is OverwhelmingDisadvantage and bank is above 1500.
